title: Report deleted workflow refs without aborting maintenance observation
body:
Native scheduled maintenance [42467413385](https://github.com/juangcarmona/lighthouse/actions/runs/42467413385/job/128690116639) failed while observing #133: `GET commits/codex%2Findependent-stage-workflows` returned `422 No commit found for SHA`. The workflow ref no longer resolves. A read-only reproduction with published SDLC 0.22.3 made 18 GET requests and failed at the same lookup. No request or model was dispatched.

Current `worker-recovery.mjs` resolves `dispatch.request.ref` without classifying a missing current ref. Historical request authentication and permission for a fresh claim must remain separate; losing the current ref must never authorize replay. This is an independent finding during #567 rollout, not a failure of its accepted before-admission callback case.

Acceptance:
- TDD covers a previously authenticated worker whose workflow branch has been deleted. Observation retains its original run/request identity and produces an actionable blocked or uncertain report instead of aborting that issue's observation.
- Distinguish confirmed missing refs from permission, network and ambiguous API failures. Do not turn arbitrary errors into permission to retry or silently report success.
- Fresh admission and resend remain denied; no model, merge, CI, product apply or recreated branch is triggered. Historical provenance is not invalidated merely because a current ref is gone.
- A batch containing this issue still observes and reports other eligible issues.
- Repeat native maintenance for #133 with no delivery effects and retain the exact report/error classification and native artifacts.

Refinement only; no triggering labels or implementation dispatch.
